command:
export SHAPE_FABRIC_TOKEN=...   # an Entra token for the Fabric API
shape generate retail --scale large --scale-mode fabric_spark \
    --fabric-workspace WORKSPACE_GUID --fabric-lakehouse LAKEHOUSE_GUID --table-prefix demo_
executed_command:
export SHAPE_FABRIC_TOKEN="$SHAPE_FABRIC_TOKEN"   # an Entra token for the Fabric API
shape generate retail --scale large --scale-mode fabric_spark \
    --fabric-workspace "$FABRIC_WORKSPACE_ID" --fabric-lakehouse "$FABRIC_LAKEHOUSE_ID" --table-prefix demo_
stdout: shape: error: refusing to write to non-local target lakehouse:// without confirmation; pass --yes or set SHAPE_CONFIRM_REMOTE=1
